findings.issue: filterExtraArgs bypass: yt-dlp accepts attached-value short flags (-oVALUE, -Pdir); '-o/tmp/evil' is not matched by the exact/'='-style isDangerousFlag check, so client extraArgs can set arbitrary output paths (arbitrary file write with --force-overwrites). Verified empirically against yt-dlp 2026.08.19.
findings.recommendation: Reject any token matching /^-[oP].+/ and switch extraArgs to a strict allowlist.

findings.issue: DANGEROUS_FLAGS blacklist misses --ffmpeg-location, --external-downloader/--downloader, --download-archive, --cookies, --cache-dir, --force-overwrites; --/parser-terminator and non-object req.body pass through.
findings.recommendation: Allowlist approach + strip bare '--' + guard req.body with {}.

findings.issue: /api/metadata lacks --no-playlist/--flat-playlist and dumpJson accumulates unbounded stdout -> OOM DoS, remotely triggerable from any webpage (GET CSRF).
findings.recommendation: Add --flat-playlist or cap stdout; add Host validation.

findings.issue: No Host/Origin header validation -> DNS rebinding gives a malicious website same-origin access to the full loopback API (read files, delete, spawn yt-dlp).
findings.recommendation: Host header middleware rejecting non-127.0.0.1/non-localhost hosts.

findings.issue: Prod deps: body-parser 2.3.0 high DoS (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828), proxy-addr critical IP-spoofing (GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h), qs moderate DoS.
findings.recommendation: npm audit fix / bump express stack.

findings.issue: Redirect Location not scheme-validated; http:// redirect throws ERR_INVALID_PROTOCOL synchronously inside response handler -> uncaughtException; also no content-length-free download cap.
findings.recommendation: Validate https: on redirects, try/catch doRequest.

findings.issue: open-file has no extension allowlist; downloaded .desktop/.bat/.lnk could execute via xdg-open/explorer.
Regex-based baseUrl strip could leave suffix; scrape triggers yt-dlp network fetches with saved options applied; --match-title regexes (python re) can hang a worker (ReDoS in yt-dlp).
CI installs with stale pnpm-lock.yaml and never runs tests; two lockfiles diverge.
findings.recommendation: Single lockfile (npm), run jest in CI.

findings.issue: --cookies string option allows arbitrary local file read attempts as cookie jar.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to downloads dir or drop option.
